outputText: Subject: Large, plant-like sculpture with an open, gaping mouth formed by twisted vines and branches, adorned with multiple lanterns hanging from its tendrils. Setting: Industrial indoor space with concrete floors, exposed ceiling pipes, and fluorescent lighting panels; reflective metal columns in the background. Framing: Vertical medium close-up focusing on the sculpture’s front and right side, capturing the mouth opening and surrounding tendrils extending onto the table surface. Lighting: Soft, warm light emitted from the lanterns on the sculpture contrasts with cooler, ambient overhead fluorescent lighting; shadows cast downward and slightly to the left. Visible transformation: Sculpture’s tendrils spread outward, some resting on the table, intermingled with scattered yellow beads, spilled brown liquid, and documents with barcodes. Continuity: Maintain the sculpture’s open mouth and vine tendrils extending onto the table with lanterns lit; preserve scattered beads and spilled liquid as key foreground elements for transition into the next scene.
